instructions: Editroom is a video editor. Times are in seconds. Video tracks are V1, V2, … (V1 is the bottom; higher tracks cover lower ones) and audio tracks are A1, A2, …. A video with sound is placed as a linked pair: moving, trimming or deleting either moves both. Placing, moving or trimming a clip, title or solid over another on the same track overwrites what's underneath, as on the timeline. Start with get_project and list_media; analyze_media finds a clip's best moments or a song's beats; look_at_media shows you a clip or photo, and get_frame shows you the cut; search_media finds shots by what they show or what's said. After looking at a clip, save what you saw with note_media; list_media gives those notes back next time, so trust a clip's notes and look again only for an exact frame. Each edit is shown to the person with your own cursor and can be undone with history. auto_edit builds a whole cut on its own, and export delivers it to a file (vertical, square or portrait too, at a loudness target).

tools.name: get_project
tools.title: Get project
tools.description: The sequence (size, frame rate, length), tracks, and every clip with its id, track, times, source, grade, sound and transition.

tools.name: list_media
tools.title: List media
tools.description: Everything in the library: id, name, kind (video, audio, image), the folder it's in, length, size, frame rate, what it shows, whether people talk in it, and notes saved from looking at it before.

tools.name: import_media
tools.title: Import media
tools.description: Adds files to the library. A folder brings in everything in it (and in folders inside it) and stays linked: files added to it later come in too, and list_media gives each item's folder.

paths.description: Absolute paths of files or folders.

tools.name: download_media
tools.title: Download media
tools.description: Downloads one music or sound file you found online and adds it to the library, ready for add_clip. Give the direct link to the audio file (an .mp3, .m4a or .wav), not a web page. Only for music that's free to use; say where you found it and what its licence allows, which is noted beside the file.

url.description: https link to the audio file itself.

name.description: What to call it, like the track and artist.

source_page.description: The page you found it on.

licence.description: What the licence says, for example "Pixabay Content License: free to use, no attribution required".

tools.name: analyze_media
tools.title: Analyze media
tools.description: For a video or photo: its best moments, scored for focus, exposure, colour, faces and steadiness. For music: tempo, beats and where bars start. Done on this Mac; cached.

moment_length.description: Length of moments to look for, in seconds (default 2).

tools.name: get_transcript
tools.title: Get transcript
tools.description: What's said in a video or sound file, heard on this Mac: its sentences and pauses with their times in the file (and each word's time if you ask). Use it for anything with people talking: to cut pauses, retakes and filler, keep sentences whole, find a moment by what's said, or put pictures over the talking. Made in the background after import; cached.

words.description: Also every word with its start and end (default false).

tools.name: look_at_media
tools.title: Look at media
tools.description: Shows you a library item: a photo, or frames from across a video in a grid, each marked with its time in the file. Use it to see what's in each shot before choosing.

frames.description: How many frames from across a video (default 6, at most 12).

times.description: Or exactly which times in the file to show, in seconds (at most 12).

tools.name: note_media
tools.title: Note what's in media
tools.description: Saves what you saw in a library item after looking at it, for later edits: what happens and where (times in the file), the people, the place, the light, how steady, and its best and weakest moments. Two or three short lines. list_media hands it back as "notes", so it needn't be looked at again. Replaces any note it had; kept on this Mac, never in the project.

notes.description: What's in it, with times, like "0-3s girl in a high chair eating noodles; 3-8s close-up, laughing at the camera, best moment 5s; bright kitchen, handheld but steady."

tools.name: get_frame
tools.title: Get frame
tools.description: A picture of the cut at a time (default: the playhead), 640 pixels on its longer side.

tools.name: add_clip
tools.title: Add clip
tools.description: Drags a library item onto the timeline. A video with sound brings its audio, linked.

start.description: Where on the timeline (default: the end of the track).

track.description: V1, V2… for video and photos; A1, A2… for audio (default V1 or A1).

source_start.description: Where in the file to start (default 0).

duration.description: How long (default: the rest of the file; 5 for a photo).

tools.name: add_title
tools.title: Add title
tools.description: Adds a text title, typed in.

track.description: A video track (default: one that's free there, above V1).

tools.name: move_clip
tools.title: Move clip
tools.description: Moves a clip (and anything linked to it) in time, and optionally to another track of the same kind.

tools.name: trim_clip
tools.title: Trim clip
tools.description: Moves a clip's start and/or end edge on the timeline (and its linked clip's). The source moves with the start edge.

tools.name: set_speed
tools.title: Set speed
tools.description: Speeds a clip (and its linked sound) up or slows it down, keeping the same part of the file: 4 plays four times as fast and a quarter as long (a timelapse), 0.5 is slow motion. Clips after it on the track move to stay butted up.

tools.name: set_speed_ramp
tools.title: Set speed ramp
tools.description: A speed ramp on a clip (and its linked sound): it plays at `around` speed, eases into `speed` for the part of the file from `from` to `to`, then eases back. For a slow-motion moment (speed 0.25, around 1), fast-normal-fast B-roll (speed 1, around 4), or ramping into a cut (`to` left out, `speed` 4: it eases up toward the clip's end). Times are seconds in the file, like source_start. The clip's length changes; clips after it on the track move to stay butted up. remove: true takes a clip's ramp away.

speed.description: The speed from `from` to `to`, 0.05...100 (1 is normal).

from.description: Seconds in the file where it reaches `speed` (default: the clip's start, so no ease in).

to.description: Seconds in the file where it starts easing back (default: the clip's end, so no ease out).

ease.description: Seconds of the file each ease takes (default 0.4).

remove.description: Take the clip's ramp away (its speed stays).

tools.name: set_captions
tools.title: Set captions
tools.description: Captions from what's said: a caption track above the video shows the words of each captioned clip in short phrases, timed to the speech, and follows every trim and move of those clips. Give clip_ids to caption those clips' speech (a video's sound is its linked audio clip); with none, every clip of people talking is captioned (sound from video files and voiceover tracks, not music). Also sets the captions' style, and with edit fixes captions: a misheard word, a name spelled right, or a caption taken out. remove: true takes captions off clip_ids, or removes the caption track with none. Returns the captions.

clip_ids.description: Clips whose speech to caption (or un-caption with remove).

position.description: Where they sit, 0.1 (top) to 0.95 (bottom) of the frame (default 0.78).

highlight.description: Light up each word as it's said (default true).

hidden.description: Hide or show the caption track (hidden captions aren't exported).

edit.description: Captions to change, each found by a timeline time inside it (as set_captions or get_project return them): the words it should say, or "" to take it out. The caption keeps its time.

tools.name: split_clip
tools.title: Split clip
tools.description: Cuts a clip (and its linked clip) in two with the blade. Returns the new right-hand pieces.

tools.name: delete_clips
tools.title: Delete clips
tools.description: Deletes clips and anything linked to them.

ripple.description: Close the gap left behind (default false).

tools.name: set_grade
tools.title: Set grade
tools.description: Colour for video, photo and title clips. Leave out what shouldn't change.

look.description: A look from list_looks, a .cube file path, or "none".

shadows_level.description: Brightness of the darks, -100...100: lift (positive) or crush them, the rest barely moves.

midtones_level.description: Brightness of the middle tones, -100...100, like gamma.

highlights_level.description: Brightness of the brights, -100...100: pull them down (negative) or push them up.

enabled.description: false switches the grade off without losing it (not shown or exported); true switches it back on.

tools.name: list_looks
tools.title: List looks
tools.description: The built-in looks for set_grade.

tools.name: set_audio
tools.title: Set level and fades
tools.description: A clip's sound level, and its fades: a sound clip's fade its sound, a video, photo, title or solid's fade its picture (in from black, out to black).

tools.name: set_transition
tools.title: Set transition
tools.description: A transition into a clip from the clip that ends where it starts on the same track.

tools.name: add_track
tools.title: Add track
tools.description: Adds an empty track on top of the others of its kind.

tools.name: set_sequence
tools.title: Set sequence
tools.description: The frame size, frame rate and dynamic range of the cut.

hdr.description: true: HDR (HLG): HDR footage keeps its highlights in the viewer and the export (10-bit HEVC); false: SDR (Rec.709).

tools.name: playback
tools.title: Playback
tools.description: Play, pause or move the playhead.

tools.name: history
tools.title: Undo or redo
tools.description: Undoes or redoes the last change (each tool call is one change).

tools.name: auto_edit
tools.title: Auto edit
tools.description: Builds a whole cut from the library on its own: best moments, cut to the beat of a song if there is one, titled. Replaces what's on the timeline (one undo brings it back).

tools.name: save_project
tools.title: Save project
tools.description: Saves the project to its file. A project that's never been saved has to be saved by the person.

tools.name: export
tools.title: Export
tools.description: Exports the cut to a file, in the background (export_status says how it's going, or set wait). Saved in the folder the person last exported to (else beside the project, else Movies); never over an existing file. Not available while making a Magic edit.

name.description: File name, without extension (default: the project's).

format.description: An MP4, or a WAV of the sound (default video).

shape.description: original is the sequence's own shape; vertical 9:16, square 1:1 and portrait 4:5 crop it.

height.description: Output height in pixels (for vertical, square and portrait: the short side), e.g. 720, 1080, 2160. Default: the sequence's.

loudness.description: Target loudness in LUFS: -14 for YouTube and social, -16 for podcasts, -23 for broadcast. Leave out to keep the levels.

reframe_x.description: For a crop: which part to keep, 0 (left) to 1 (right). Default 0.5.

wait.description: Wait until it's done (up to about 4 minutes) instead of returning straight away.

tools.name: export_status
tools.title: Export status
tools.description: Exports started from Editroom (by anyone): their files and whether they're waiting, running, done or failed.

tools.name: search_media
tools.title: Search media
tools.description: Finds library items by what they show (people, places, things: "beach", "dog", "car at night") and/or what's said in them, with the times in each file. Much quicker than looking at or transcribing each one. Seen and heard on this Mac in the background after import, so a new file may not be searchable yet.

shows.description: Words for what's in the shot; every word has to match.

tools.name: set_marker
tools.title: Set marker
tools.description: Adds a marker on the timeline, or changes one (give marker_id, from get_project). Use markers when asked to mark moments (beats, highlights, places to cut).

time.description: Timeline seconds (needed for a new marker).

tools.name: delete_markers
tools.title: Delete markers
tools.description: Removes markers.

tools.name: set_in_out
tools.title: Set in and out
tools.description: The in/out range: what Loop plays and what export can be limited to (range_only).

tools.name: set_transform
tools.title: Position, scale and zoom
tools.description: Moves and scales a video, photo or solid in the frame, for reframing (keeping a subject in a vertical crop, a picture-in-picture). With zoom, it animates over the clip between the full frame and this scale and framing: pushing in on a moment, or following the action in a screen recording. A title's place is set with set_title_style.

scale.description: 1 fits the frame; 2 is twice as big (0.05...10). With zoom, how far in it goes (default 2).

x.description: Offset of its centre across, as a fraction of the frame's width (0 is centred, 0.5 is the right edge).

y.description: Offset down, as a fraction of the frame's height (0 is centred, positive is lower).

focus_x.description: Instead of x: the point to frame, across the picture (0 left edge, 0.5 centre, 1 right edge). Scaled up, the picture is placed so that point is centred, as near as its edges allow.

focus_y.description: Instead of y: the point to frame, down the picture (0 top, 0.5 centre, 1 bottom).

zoom.description: Animate: in (full frame to this framing), in_out (in, hold, back out at the end), out (from this framing back to the full frame), or off (stay at this framing).

zoom_seconds.description: How long each move takes (default a quarter of the clip, 0.5 to 2 seconds).

zoom_start.description: Seconds into the clip when the move starts: for in and in_out, when it starts moving in (default 0); for out, when it starts moving out (default so it ends with the clip).

zoom_smooth.description: Eased in and out (the default), or false for an even pace.

reset.description: Back to fitted and centred, with no zoom.

tools.name: set_title_style
tools.title: Title style
tools.description: A title's words and look. Leave out what shouldn't change.

font.description: A font family installed on this Mac, or "System".

tools.name: freeze_frame
tools.title: Freeze frame
tools.description: Holds one frame of a video clip: the clip is cut there, the held frame goes in, and what follows on its tracks moves along to make room.

at.description: Timeline time inside the clip (default: its middle).

tools.name: reverse_clip
tools.title: Reverse
tools.description: Plays a clip (and its linked sound) backwards; again plays it forwards.

tools.name: detach_audio
tools.title: Detach audio
tools.description: Unlinks a video from its sound, so each can be moved, trimmed or deleted on its own.

clip_id.description: The video's or its sound's id.

tools.name: duplicate_clip
tools.title: Duplicate clip
tools.description: Copies a clip (and anything linked to it) to another time.

start.description: Where the copy starts (default: straight after the clip).

tools.name: set_track
tools.title: Set track
tools.description: A track's switches and level.

tools.name: add_solid
tools.title: Add solid
tools.description: Adds a solid colour (a background, a flash, a colour card).

track.description: A video track (default: one that's free there).

tools.name: set_solid_color
tools.title: Solid colour
tools.description: Changes a solid's colour.
